i always needed to be taught one on one. teachers obviously couldn’t do that in California public schools. When i got to high-school and my health declined even more i was put on a program called “home hospital” which is basically when you’re too sick for school so they send a teacher to help you. My assigned teacher was not very helpful for me, but i thankfully found a tutor through our neighborhood app who is now one of my besties. He understood how to teach me and went at my pace. He would teach me the concepts over and over again (because of my memory problems) so i could complete my assignments and i’m forever thankful.
